attchmntText: Motisons Jewellers Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Motisons Jewellers Limited reports no deviation or variation in the utilization of proceeds from its Qualified Institutions Placement. The company raised 150 Crores on 11.06.2026. The disclosure covers the quarter ended 30-09-2026. Funds were allocated for working capital requirements and general corporate purposes. For working capital, the original allocation was 130.00 Crores. Utilization during the quarter was 0.63 Crores. Total utilization stands at 130.00 Crores. For general corporate purposes, the original allocation was 9.37 Crores. Utilization during the quarter was 9.37 Crores. Total utilization stands at 9.37 Crores. The monitoring agency is CRISIL Ratings Limited. The Audit Committee and auditors have raised no comments. Bhavesh Surolia, Company Secretary, signed the letter. Sandeep Chhabra, Chairman and Whole Time Director, signed the statement.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended September 30th, 2026.
voiceSummary: Motisons Jewellers Limited filed the Final Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report covers the utilization of proceeds from the Qualified Institutional Placement issued on June 11, 2026. The revised net proceeds amount to Rs 139.37 crore, revised from Rs 140.40 crore due to higher issue expenses. The Board of Directors approved this revision via a resolution dated August 12, 2026. The company utilized Rs 129.37 crore during the quarter. Rs 10.00 crore was fully utilized towards general corporate purposes. No deviations from the objects of the issue were observed. The monitoring account balance is Nil as of October 21, 2026.

attchmntText: Motisons Jewellers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Motisons Jewellers Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on 14th November, 2026. The company completed a Qualified Institutions Placement in June 2026, issuing 13,57,46,600 equity shares at Rs. 11.05 per share, aggregating Rs. 1,49,99,99,930. Net proceeds were Rs. 13,936.80 Lakhs. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, the company reported a Net Loss After Tax of Rs. 1,091.96 Lakhs. Revenue from Operations was Rs. 10,733.68 Lakhs. Total Expenses stood at Rs. 11,825.64 Lakhs. The Basic Earnings Per Share was negative Rs. 12.86. The Auditor’s Limited Review Report stated that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements in the financial results.
